decision_conditions: <p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt; margin-left:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:6.0pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="color:#0d0d0d">The proposed development, by way of the conversion of family sized home to create two smaller residential units, which fails to re-instate a 3-bedroom family sized property is not acceptable as it would create the loss of 1 existing family sized dwellinghouse within this immediate area, which is contrary to Policy 15 and 20 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024). </span></span></span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt; margin-left:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:6.0pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="color:#0d0d0d">The proposed conversion would create two small residential units which fail to meet the national described space standards by way of overall gross internal area, bedroom size, and outdoor amenity space, and therefore the proposal would create sub-standard accommodation to the detriment of the existing occupiers, and future occupiers of the properties which is unacceptable and contrary to Policy 56 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024), Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), and the </span>Technical Housing Standards – nationally described space standard (2015). </span></span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt; margin-left:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:6.0pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;">The proposal for 1 car parking space for each unit, in relation to the existing dropped curb position, would result in obstructed pedestrian movement onto the site and would not provide a clear, or legible way of movement or parking of both cars, which is contrary to Policy 60 and 66 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024). </span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt; margin-left:0cm; margin-right:-34.6pt; margin-top:18.0pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">The proposed submission does not provide adequate cycle parking facilities and given the limited space of the units it is not clear or robust evidence to show that this could be incorporated sufficiently into the dwellinghouses and therefore the development is not shown to comply with Policy 60 and 61 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).</span></span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt; margin-left:0cm; margin-right:-34.6pt; margin-top:18.0pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">The applicant has failed to enter into a S106 agreement and therefore is not in compliance with Policies G6, T3 and T4 of the London Plan and Policies 5, 10, 60, 61, 62, 65, 66, 79, 81 and 94 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan LP1 (2024), specifically in relation to the following planning obligations requirements:</span></span></span></p><ul><li><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">Car-free clause in the event of a CPZ</span></span></span></li><li><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">£650 Epping Forest SAMMs contribution.</span></span></span></li><li><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">Financial contribution of 5% for S106 monitoring fees.</span></span></span></li></ul>
description: Subdivision of land to create two plots to include 1 x 2 - bedroom house and 1 x self-contained dwelling.
